map.多为先天性良性变异，收缩期血管被心肌压迫、舒张期恢复，多数人无症状；仅少数深在、: Mostly a congenital benign variant - the vessel is compressed by myocardium in systole and recovers in diastole; most people are asymptomatic. Only a few deep, proximal or spasm-associated bridges cause exertional ischemia presenting as chest pain, needing individualized rather than excessive intervention.
